exposure: Use of a web-based decision aid about birth options after cesarean
outcome: Informed, patient-centered decision making about mode of delivery
cohort: 100 women with singleton pregnancies between 19/0 to 36/6 weeks, ≤2 prior cesareans, and no contraindications to TOLAC
finding: A web-based birth options patient-centered decision aid for TOLAC eligible women can be integrated into prenatal Telehealth and may improve the quality of decision making about mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Women in the decision aid group were more likely to make an informed, patient-centered decision about mode of delivery.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at enrollment was 31 weeks
